task_message:
Case M16: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 400x400x270 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is finished. Summary:

- **Lesion found:** a lobulated, strongly T2-hyperintense mass (~5 cm) in the right gluteal/peritrochanteric soft tissues, unilateral and clearly distinct from the midline pelvic structures (bladder/rectum).
- **Segmentation:** started with a 4-vertex edge lasso on axial slice 90, then added a positive point for the missed lateral lobule, accepted the automatic candidate covering the superior lobule (multilobulated rim), filled holes, and ran a model refine to snap the boundary.
- **Verification:** reviewed the mask on orthogonal slices plus the past-the-end panels (axial, coronal, sagittal) — the upper/lower and all side ends taper correctly with no lesion tissue left outside, no leaks into adjacent fat/vessels, and a single connected component.
- **Result:** final mask v5, volume 44.4 mL, confidence medium (structure identity vs. incidental pelvic findings judged, boundary itself follows the bright mass well).
